# LLVM trunk build for OpenMP GPU offload
# ========================================
# Updated: 2026-05-29
#
# Builds clang/clang++ from llvm-project main with the Offload runtime
# enabled, so OpenMP target offload (-fopenmp -fopenmp-targets=nvptx64-...
# --offload-arch=sm_XX) actually dispatches to the GPU.
#
# Why build from source: RHEL 9's stock clang-19 has the offload codegen
# support but does NOT ship libomptarget.rtl.cuda.so (no CUDA plugin),
# so omp_get_num_devices() returns 0 with the system clang. Same on most
# distros. Building LLVM trunk with the Offload preset gives us the
# missing runtime plugin.
#
# Tested on:
#   Host:    RHEL 9, x86_64, NVIDIA H100 (compute capability 9.0)
#   Driver:  580.65.06
#   CUDA:    13.0 at /usr/local/cuda
#   Bootstrap compiler: gcc 11.5.0 (Red Hat 11.5.0-5)
#   MPI:     OpenMPI 5.0.8 (--with-cuda=/usr/local/cuda, UCX 1.20)
#
# For other GPU architectures: change every "sm_90" below to your
# target (sm_80 = A100, sm_100 = GB200, gfx90a = MI200/AMD, etc.)
# and adjust LLVM_RUNTIME_TARGETS accordingly.

# 1. System prerequisites
#    cmake (>= 3.20) and gnu make are usually already present on RHEL.
#    Need ninja (use any python venv) and 32-bit glibc headers — LLVM
#    builds 32-bit sanitizer variants by default and needs them.
sudo dnf install -y glibc-devel.i686
source /mnt/data/myenv/bin/activate    # any python 3.11+ venv works
pip install ninja

# 2. Clone llvm-project (shallow saves ~30 GB and most of the wall time)
cd /mnt/data
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git
cd llvm-project; mkdir build; cd build

# 3. Configure
#
#    Critical:
#    - CC=gcc CXX=g++ at the front of the cmake command. If your shell
#      has CC/CXX set to nvc/nvc++ (e.g. left over from SBD GPU builds)
#      cmake silently picks them up and the LLVM build fails because
#      nvc++ doesn't accept clang flags in feature probes (e.g.
#      "nvc++-Error-Unknown switch: -Wno-c99-extensions").
#    - LLVM_RUNTIME_TARGETS must include BOTH "default" (host x86 —
#      gives us libomp.so and omp.h) AND "nvptx64-nvidia-cuda" (device-
#      side runtime — gives us libomptarget-nvptx.bc). If you forget
#      "default" you get a clang that can compile -fopenmp source but
#      omp.h is missing at user-program build time.
#    - Don't use the unmodified Offload.cmake preset (-C cache file).
#      It hard-codes amdgcn-amd-amdhsa, which fights with our
#      Native;NVPTX-only targets list and lld can't link AMD code at
#      install time. Easier to skip the preset and set the same
#      variables explicitly.

CC=gcc CXX=g++ \
cmake ../llvm -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/mnt/data/llvm-offload \
  -DLLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS="clang;clang-tools-extra;lld" \
  -DLLVM_ENABLE_RUNTIMES="compiler-rt;libunwind;libcxx;libcxxabi;openmp;offload" \
  -DLLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD="Native;NVPTX" \
  -DLLVM_RUNTIME_TARGETS="default;nvptx64-nvidia-cuda" \
  -DRUNTIMES_nvptx64-nvidia-cuda_LLVM_ENABLE_RUNTIMES="compiler-rt;libc;openmp;libcxx;libcxxabi" \
  -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=/usr/local/cuda

# 4. Build + install (~45-60 min on a 160-core box with -j64)
ninja -j64 install

# 5. Verify the install populated host runtime + CUDA plugin
ls /mnt/data/llvm-offload/bin/clang++
ls /mnt/data/llvm-offload/lib/clang/*/include/omp.h
ls /mnt/data/llvm-offload/lib/libomp*.so* /mnt/data/llvm-offload/lib/libomptarget*.so*
# All four checks must succeed. If "libomptarget*" is missing, the host
# runtime didn't get built — re-check LLVM_RUNTIME_TARGETS includes
# "default", reconfigure, ninja install again.

# 6. Smoke test on the GPU node
cat > /tmp/omp_offload_test.cpp <<'EOF'
#include <omp.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main() {
    printf("OpenMP devices: %d\n", omp_get_num_devices());
    int data[10] = {0};
    #pragma omp target teams distribute parallel for map(tofrom: data[0:10])
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) data[i] = i*i;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) printf("%d ", data[i]);
    printf("\n");
    return 0;
}
EOF
CLANGXX=/mnt/data/llvm-offload/bin/clang++
$CLANGXX -fopenmp -fopenmp-targets=nvptx64-nvidia-cuda --offload-arch=sm_90 \
    /tmp/omp_offload_test.cpp -o /tmp/omp_offload_test
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/mnt/data/llvm-offload/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH /tmp/omp_offload_test
# Expected:  OpenMP devices: 1
#            0 1 4 9 16 25 36 49 64 81
# If "OpenMP devices: 0" — the runtime isn't finding the GPU; re-check
# step 5 outputs, especially that libomptarget.rtl.cuda*.so exists.

# 7. Build SBD with OpenMP offload (instead of Thrust)
#    In apps/chemistry_tpb_selected_basis_diagonalization/Configuration:
#
#      SBD_PATH=../..
#      CCCOM=mpicxx
#      CCFLAGS = -O3 -fopenmp -fopenmp-targets=nvptx64-nvidia-cuda \
#                --offload-arch=sm_90 -DSBD_TRADMODE -DUSE_GPU \
#                -DUSE_OMP_OFFLOAD -fopenmp-offload-mandatory \
#                -foffload-lto -std=c++17
#      LDFLAGS = -fopenmp --offload-arch=sm_90 -foffload-lto
#      SYSLIB  = -L/opt/ohpc/pub/libs/gnu14/openblas/0.3.29/lib -lopenblas
#
#    Force OpenMPI's mpicxx to use the new clang++ (default on this box
#    is nvc++ for SBD's Thrust path):
export OMPI_CXX=/mnt/data/llvm-offload/bin/clang++

# 8. Run.  On OpenMPI 5.0.8 + CUDA 13, the smcuda BTL emits a noisy
#    "cuMemHostRegister return value: 1" warning at startup (cosmetic,
#    falls back to staged copies — numerics unaffected). Suppress by
#    routing through UCX-only:
mpirun --mca pml ucx --mca osc ucx --mca btl '^smcuda,vader' \
       -x UCX_TLS=cuda_copy,cuda_ipc,sm,self \
       --allow-run-as-root -np 8 -x OMP_NUM_THREADS=10 \
       ./diag --fcidump ../../data/fe4s4/fcidump.txt \
              --adetfile ../../data/fe4s4/alpha_dets_27901.txt \
              --method 0 --block 10 --tolerance 1.0e-5 \
              --adet_comm_size 4 --bdet_comm_size 2

# Validated results (Fe4S4 27,901-det subspace, 8x H100):
#   Energy = -326.821832430028 Ha   (matches Thrust build to 12 digits)
#   Final mult (single H|psi>): 23.0 s    (vs 36.5 s for Thrust build)
#   Davidson 10 iters:          315 s     (vs 371 s for Thrust)

# Known issues
# ------------
# - cuMemHostRegister INVALID_VALUE warning at MPI startup is an
#   OpenMPI 5.0.8 <-> CUDA 13 corner case in the smcuda BTL. Cosmetic;
#   suppressed by --mca btl '^smcuda,vader' as in step 8.
# - LLVM_RUNTIME_TARGETS without "default" produces a working clang but
#   no host openmp + no omp.h. Symptom: user-program builds fail with
#   "'omp.h' file not found".  Add "default" and reinstall.
# - Don't use NVHPC's mpicxx for OMP-offload SBD builds — it auto-adds
#   /opt/nvidia/.../compilers/include/, which uses GCC builtins clang
#   doesn't recognize (__builtin_isnanf, __builtin_isnanl errors).
#   Use the system OpenMPI mpicxx with OMPI_CXX=clang++ as in step 7.
# - System gcc 11.5 advertises -foffload=nvptx-none but doesn't ship
#   accel-cc1 / mkoffload, so gcc OpenMP offload doesn't work
#   end-to-end. Stay with the LLVM toolchain we just built.
